title: Shark waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail fin -->
  <polygon points='18,52 4,34 8,52 4,68' fill='#5fb8d8' stroke='#8fd6ee' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <path d='M18 52 Q30 36 52 38 Q74 40 82 52 Q74 64 52 66 Q30 68 18 52 Z' fill='#4ba8cc'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <path d='M30 60 Q52 68 76 57 Q60 66 40 64 Q34 63 30 60 Z' fill='#bfe9f5'/>
  <!-- dorsal fin -->
  <polygon points='46,40 40,22 58,38' fill='#5fb8d8' stroke='#8fd6ee' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='48' r='4' fill='#1e3a4a'/>
  <circle cx='63.5' cy='46.5' r='1.5' fill='#e8f8ff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M65 58 Q72 62 79 57' fill='none' stroke='#1e3a4a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- teeth -->
  <polygon points='67,58 69.5,62 72,58' fill='#f4fbff'/>
  <polygon points='73,58 75.5,62 78,57' fill='#f4fbff'/>
  <!-- waving pectoral fin / arm -->
  <path d='M52 60 Q46 74 40 82' fill='none' stroke='#4ba8cc' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 60 Q46 74 40 82' fill='none' stroke='#8fd6ee' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-dasharray='0.1 6' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- fin hand -->
  <path d='M40 82 Q34 88 38 91 Q42 92 44 87 Q46 92 50 90 Q52 86 47 82 Z' fill='#5fb8d8' stroke='#8fd6ee' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- small sparkle near hand -->
  <path d='M58 84 l2 4 4 2 -4 2 -2 4 -2 -4 -4 -2 4 -2 Z' fill='#fff6a8'/>
</svg>
